attribution.only_topology_change: remove false bidirectional casting edge de427
attribution.counterfactual: Baseline minus de427 has exactly candidate traversal adjacency and weighted costs; other six edits are metadata only.
attribution.interpretation: Cald rank shifts on unchanged raw distances are distribution effects of the removed edge, not unrelated topology changes.
expected_topology_effects: Only Operațiunea Monstrul weighted guesses toward Salată de boeuf and Sarmale de Crăciun worsen; hop distances and reachability remain identical across all 265 targets.
Other changed Cald ranks arise from reordering that single guess within each four-hop bucket; 263 target feedback profiles remain exactly unchanged.

All 30 changed Lanț corridor menus are at the two removed-edge endpoints. Twenty-nine use the same history prefix and remove the false direct hop; one uses a new legal prefix after that false edge is unavailable. All 123 optimal distances, strict route DAGs, branch profiles, and starting menus remain unchanged.
attribution.collateral_requiring_repair: Three exact recipe-extension scopes fail closed on approved description, label, or endpoint-degree changes. Seven additions disappear even though no challenge recipe uses de427. Preserve them through reviewed snapshot carry-forward.

alchimie.carry_forward_acceptance: All 80 baseline playable projection digests must be restored exactly after the supported snapshot refresh; restoring only counts is insufficient.

quick.binding_action: Rebuild graph/pack/ranking digest bindings using existing generators; this audit does not install or reapprove boards.

required_actions: Refresh the exact affected recipe extension snapshots through a supported reviewed generator; preserve core recipes, all addition identities, outputs, strengths, and recipe hashes.
Rebuild required quick and ranked pack bindings after the integrated KG/selection work.
limits: Mechanical downstream comparison is not a new human fun/familiarity review.
Cald checks every KG-native guess and reviewed native proxy scorer; projection-only vocabulary is not separately enumerated.
Lant route DAG/corridor membership covers all shortest/par+2 structural routes. Menus use one deterministic shortest prefix per corridor node, not every cyclic player history.
Candidate does not include later recipe-snapshot refresh or selection/ranking changes. Those need separate exact review and integrated validation.
No source, served fixture, review approval, session store, or save limit was modified.

replay_helper.note: Run from repo root using the native Django runtime. Helper uses immutable baseline catalogs from Git and pinned KG input; writes only a scratch rerun report, not this durable review. Additional frozen derivation comparison verified separately in 4.37 seconds.
